settings.title: AI assistant
settings.help: Suggests replies in the chat (✨ button or Ctrl/Cmd+J) using your store data, your products and the customer's orders. It never sends anything on its own: you pick, edit and send.
settings.knowledgePlaceholder: Opening hours, exchange and return policies, delivery times, FAQs, bank transfer details, etc.
settings.knowledgeHelp: It only uses this and your store data: if something is missing, it suggests asking instead of making things up.
settings.handoff: When the case needs a person
settings.handoffPlaceholder: E.g.: I'm passing you to Ana from customer care, she'll reply in a few minutes.
settings.privacy: The latest messages of the conversation, that customer's orders and these details are sent to the AI. Included AI: up to 200 replies per day.
settings.helpAutopilot: Replies to your customers on WhatsApp ON ITS OWN using your store data, your products and their orders. When a person is needed, it hands the chat over and notifies you.
settings.handoffAutopilotHelp: Autopilot sends this message when handing over and pauses the AI in that conversation.
settings.privacyByo: The latest messages of the conversation, that customer's orders and these details are sent to your AI provider (with your key, at your cost). Safety cap: 2000 replies per day.
settings.metaPolicy: WhatsApp Business policy: the assistant only serves this store's customers about its products and orders (it's not a general-purpose chatbot).

mode.title: Mode
mode.copilotHelp: Suggests replies in the chat; you pick, edit and send.
mode.autopilotHelp: Replies to your customers on its own and passes you the cases that need a person.
mode.autopilotWarning: The AI will send messages to your customers without you reviewing them. Fill in what it should know and check conversations often. If you reply yourself, the AI stays quiet for 30 minutes in that chat, and you can pause it per conversation.

provider.title: AI provider
provider.shopifreeHelp: Included in your Business plan, nothing to set up.
provider.byoHelp: Use your own key: usage is billed to your provider account and doesn't use Shopifree's quota.
provider.keepKey: Leave empty to keep the saved key
provider.keyDeleted: Key deleted. Shopifree AI is used now.
provider.deleteConfirm: Delete the key? The assistant will go back to Shopifree AI.
provider.keyPrivacy: The key is stored only on our server and is never shown in full again.
